fact: African Law Matters analyst Tashinga Magaya writes that the National AI Strategy is not a law, that the proposed regulator has no enabling Act, and that the Cyber and Data Protection Act is the law that applies to AI today, so no AI-specific rule is in force and she urges that a draft AI Act be introduced within twelve to eighteen months.

The article states that no AI act exists in Zimbabwe, that the National Digital Regulatory Committee named in the strategy has no enabling legislation, and that a draft AI Act is still to be introduced to Parliament; as_of is the article's published date.
